about: Base translation file for Team Vacation Planner. To add a language: copy the shape into i18n/<code>.json (same groups and keys, values = translated text, plus the _lang block), then run check.mjs and apply.mjs. See i18n/README.md.
rules: Translate meaning, not words: short, natural interface language a colleague would use at work.
Keep every {placeholder} exactly as written (same letters, same braces); move it where the grammar needs it.
Texts with a number before or after them have no plural logic: choose a form that reads acceptably with any number.

Keep product names and formats unchanged: Team Vacation Planner may be translated as a description only in 'brand'; Workoșenie, Buy Me a Coffee, PIN, PDF, Excel, CSV, ICS, QR, JSON, WhatsApp, Telegram, LinkedIn, Facebook, X stay as they are.
Keep symbols such as ½, ·, →, –, …, €, % and emoji where they are.
'max' is a soft limit in characters for labels on buttons, tabs and chips: stay under it when the language allows.
Lists ('items') keep the same number of entries in the same order.
No machine-sounding literalisms; no English left over except the names above.
Use one term per concept everywhere (see glossary) and one register (polite-neutral, addressing the user directly).

glossary.vacation / leave: Paid annual leave an employee books. Use the everyday workplace word.
glossary.team: The group of colleagues sharing one calendar.
glossary.approver: The member who approves vacation requests.
glossary.owner / creator: The person who created the team.
glossary.allowance (PTO): Vacation days a person may take per year.
glossary.carry-over: Unused days moved to the next year.
glossary.coverage: Share of the team at work on a given day.
glossary.overlap / clash: Several people away on the same day (clash = too many).
glossary.bridge day: A working day between a public holiday and a weekend, worth taking off.
glossary.business trip: Work travel, shown separately from vacation.
glossary.heatmap: Calendar coloured by how many people are away.
glossary.timeline: Horizontal bars per person across the year.
glossary.PIN: The 4 to 6 digit code each member sets.
glossary.setup code: One-time 8-digit code given after a PIN reset.

lang_block.fonts: CSS font-family fallbacks if the script is not Latin/Cyrillic/Greek, else empty
